comparison.objective: Keep an automated loader's nest supplied one blank at a time.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated timed pick-and-place into a constrained nest while avoiding another moving arm.
comparison.success_condition: Five blanks correctly presented and carried to the chute; no arm collision or double loading; 1 s success hold.
comparison.reason: Both involve multiple workpieces, but this tests synchronized replenishment, not physical separation by aperture and granular agitation.
